# f5xc_api_testing (Data Source)

This is the api testing type

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Api Testing - Full

data "f5xc_api_testing" "example" {
  name      = f5xc_api_testing.example.name
  namespace = f5xc_api_testing.example.namespace
}
```

### Nested Schema for `domains.credentials.credentials_choice.api_key.value`

<a id="nestedatt--domains--credentials--credentials_choice--api_key--value--secret_info_choice"></a>
### Nested Schema for `domains.credentials.credentials_choice.api_key.value.secret_info_choice`

Read-Only:

- `blindfold_secret_info` (Attributes) Blindfold Secret Blindfold Secret is used for the secrets managed by F5XC Secret Management Service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--domains--credentials--credentials_choice--api_key--value--secret_info_choice--blindfold_secret_info))
- `clear_secret_info` (Attributes) Clear Secret Clear Secret is used for the secrets that are not encrypted (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--domains--credentials--credentials_choice--api_key--value--secret_info_choice--clear_secret_info))
- `none` (Boolean) None No private key will be stored or used. Choose this only when you need a public certificate for verification (e.g., validating SAML/JWT signatures). Not suitable for TLS or any use case that requires presenting a certificate, those will fail without a private key.

<a id="nestedatt--domains--credentials--credentials_choice--api_key--value--secret_info_choice--blindfold_secret_info"></a>
### Nested Schema for `domains.credentials.credentials_choice.api_key.value.secret_info_choice.blindfold_secret_info`

Read-Only:

- `decryption_provider` (String) Decryption Provider Name of the Secret Management Access object that contains information about the backend Secret Management service.
- `location` (String) Location Location is the uri_ref. It could be in url format for string:/// Or it could be a path if the store provider is an http/https location
- `store_provider` (String) Store Provider Name of the Secret Management Access object that contains information about the store to get encrypted bytes This field needs to be provided only if the url scheme is not string:///


<a id="nestedatt--domains--credentials--credentials_choice--api_key--value--secret_info_choice--clear_secret_info"></a>
### Nested Schema for `domains.credentials.credentials_choice.api_key.value.secret_info_choice.clear_secret_info`

Read-Only:

- `provider` (String) Provider Name of the Secret Management Access object that contains information about the store to get encrypted bytes This field needs to be provided only if the url scheme is not string:///
- `url` (String, Sensitive) URL URL of the secret. Currently supported URL schemes is string:///. For string:/// scheme, Secret needs to be encoded Base64 format. When asked for this secret, caller will get Secret bytes after Base64 decoding.
